dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Neurologic Wilson disease due to pathogenic ATP7B-mediated copper accumulation, presenting with a progressive supranuclear downgaze palsy and cerebellar ataxia

ALTERNATIVE: Progressive supranuclear palsy (Richardson syndrome)

ALTERNATIVE: Niemann–Pick disease type C

ALTERNATIVE: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 (Machado–Joseph disease)
